audiences: Laboratory operator finding and updating today’s demo samples
design_brief.scope: One queue restructure and one public hero, autonomous implementation authorized
design_brief.stack: Standalone HTML/CSS and baseline JavaScript; no dependencies or remote mutation
design_brief.data: Four supplied demo records; localStorage fieldwater-status; no auth, remote API or analytics
design_brief.behavior_contract: Preserve IDs, field names, supplied records, search/filter/reset, native required validation, local status persistence, Escape dismissal, focus return, theme toggle and anchors

decisions: Queue uses aligned sample/station/due/status/action rows to compare due times without repeated cards. Narrow layout restores visible metadata labels.
Status text is paired with a colored dot; no status relies on color alone.
Graphite actions, warm neutral canvas, system sans and teal water accent form a project variant of the selected direction.

Hero composition A places a plan-first heading beside a field-to-laboratory sample drawing; composition B would use a full-width heading over a horizontal field/analysis process. A was selected because the service and action stay adjacent on desktop and precede the drawing on mobile.
Hero depicts one labelled sample rather than invented measurements, safety results or accreditation.

checks.result: 4 samples, native dialog valid, Escape returns focus to Update FW-104
No horizontal overflow at 320, 375 and 1280 CSS px in light and dark. Computed backgrounds match themes.
All body and descendant computed font sizes doubled once. Final 375 and 1280 layouts have no out-of-viewport elements. Screenshots reviewed for line overlap and clipping.

North search and Received filter return 2; missing query shows empty state; reset returns 4. Save changes FW-104 to Processing, stores locally and survives reload. Escape, Cancel and Save return focus. Empty required status invalidates native form. Theme toggle sets aria-pressed true. Methods anchor resolves.
Primary mailto is sampling@example.com, visibly labelled demonstration address. Secondary action resolves #methods.

Light/dark text roles >=5.55:1. Focus >=6.84:1. Essential control boundaries >=3.64:1 against page and >=3.84:1 against control surface. Primary text >=12.88:1. Ratios calculated from rendered solid CSS roles. Placeholder uses measured muted role.
Keyboard Tab shows solid 3px focus. Native modal dialog keeps page inert. Chromium briefly reports BODY during tab wrap, matching baseline. Forced-colors active keeps solid focus outline.
Reduced-motion media emulation active; no animation or transitions added. User text-spacing overrides cause no horizontal overflow on either page.
All baseline IDs and field names preserved. No external asset href/src. Inline behavior source unchanged except adding status data attribute for CSS.

limitations: Chromium only; no physical-device, screen-reader or other-engine tests.
Scripting-disabled and storage-blocked states were not tested; queue retains the supplied JavaScript behavior contract.
No system automatic theme selection added because supplied theme is a manual toggle.
Composition alternative recorded as a bounded sketch description; only selected composition built.
Some enlarged hero words wrap across lines; full content remains readable.
No server build applies to standalone HTML.
tool_count_basis: 14 functions.exec orchestration calls. No delegation, network requests, added dependencies or writes outside this output directory.
resolved_failures: Initial 200% mobile hero overflow fixed with zero-minimum grid tracks, heading wrapping and HTML diagram labels.
Initial 200% mobile metadata label overlap fixed with max-content label tracks.

self_review_scores.limits: Self-review based on inspected browser states, not independent taste approval or certification.
